sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) Ocean Box Brokerage

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (creates UIAF), Ley 1121 de 2006 (money laundering criminal regime), Ley 1621 de 2013 (tipping-off and information exchange), DIAN Resolución 000164 de 2021 (beneficial owner reporting), Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular Básica Jurídica (Circular Externa 100-000005 de 2022) and UIAF Circular Básica Jurídica for AML/CFT obligations and UBO registration.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Bylaws (Acta de Constitución y Estatutos)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public where the SAS deed is executed

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate Power of Attorney for Incorporation Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or competent authority in the jurisdiction of grantor

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal)
Legalized Beneficial Owner Declaration of Each Direct Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or competent authority in the shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Passport Copies of Directors, Legal Representatives, and UBOs

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, European Union Consolidated List, Colombian UIAF-published national measures, and domestic PEP registers in accordance with UIAF Circular Básica Jurídica. Enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons, their family members, and close associates; perpetual transaction monitoring for NVOCC cash and wire settlements; risk-based customer and counterparty onboarding with refresher screening at intervals of not more than 90 days.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) administered by the local Cámara de Comercio, including online pre-approval through the Chamber of Commerce platform.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory Spanish-language corporate naming; the proposed name must contain 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada' or its acronym 'S.A.S.'. Foreign words are conditionally accepted when transliterated into Latin script and must not create ambiguity. The name must be distinctive, not false, and must not be identical or misleadingly similar to any existing registered name in the same registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written reconsideration petition with the same Chamber of Commerce within ten business days from notification, arguing prior right, registrability, or absence of conflict. If the Chamber sustains the rejection, the applicant may appeal administratively to the Superintendencia de Sociedades under the Código de Comercio and RUES procedural instructions, requesting de novo review of the name conflict decision within the following fifteen business days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permission is granted for a virtual registered office or third-party registered-agent address for an S.A.S. engaged in NVOCC freight forwarding, provided that: (i) the address is a physical location in Colombia, (ii) official notices and judicial or administrative service of process can be physically tendered, (iii) corporate books and records are retained in Colombia, and (iv) the registered office address filed with the Chamber of Commerce is accurate and continuously updated. Virtual office arrangements without physical service capacity are not permissible.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% to 25% annual probability; unannounced on-site inspections are carried out by UIAF, Superintendencia de Sociedades, and the local Chamber of Commerce in AML/CFT audits and commercial verification actions targeting Medium_Risk_Enhanced NVOCC operators.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per RUES fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of SAS incorporation deed and bylaws
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial statutory tariff based on authorized capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille processing for foreign entity documents
Certified Spanish translation of foreign corporate and UBO documents
SAS commercial registration and Matrícula Mercantil
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff based on capital and activity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial UBO report filing to DIAN
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT compliance manual and tailored risk assessment for NVOCC activities
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for medium-risk enhanced due diligence

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, and domestic sanctions screening database subscription (first year)
Registered office virtual service package (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for virtual office with service-of-process capacity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Business license and NVOCC operating license pre-application due diligence
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market legal fee for transportation license feasibility

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada - S.A.S.), arts. 1-5, 10, 17-20, 25-27 and 45; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), arts. 110, 354 and 373; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, arts. 2.2.2.1.1 et seq.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá), operating through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social - RUES, supervised by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation document) executed by the shareholder(s) and registered with the Chamber of Commerce; elevated to Escritura Pública before a notary only when real property is contributed
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for the S.A.S.; capital may be fixed at COP 1 or any higher authorized amount. Subscribed monetary contributions must be fully paid within two (2) years from incorporation. No escrow bank account or promotional capital deposit is required; payment may be evidenced by bank receipt or a sworn contribution affidavit.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The undersigned sole shareholder of [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S., holding 100% of its issued share capital, adopts by unanimous written consent, in lieu of a first board meeting, the following resolutions. 1. Share Subscription and Payment. The authorized capital of COP [X], represented by [N] ordinary shares, is subscribed and paid in full on this date under Clause 5 of the by-laws. 2. Registered Office. The principal place of business is fixed at [ADDRESS, CITY]; the Legal Representative is instructed to register the domicile before the Chamber of Commerce and DIAN. 3. Officers. [NAME], identity [No.], is appointed Manager and Legal Representative with all powers under the by-laws, and is authorized to obtain the NVOCC operating license and open bank accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name verification, provisional NIT pre-assignment and shareholder identity validation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered office city via the RUES online portal (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the RUES or the Chamber's virtual window and generate the Certificado de Homonimia for the proposed corporate name; submit the Formulario Único de Registro (FUR) preliminary data to obtain the provisional NIT (pre-RUT) and the payment certificate for registry rights; verify that the proposed name is not identical or confusingly similar to existing entities and that the chosen address is within the Chamber's jurisdiction.
required_dossiers: Valid identity document of the sole shareholder or legal representative (cédula de ciudadanía or passport)
Notarized power of attorney if acting through an attorney-in-fact
Proposed corporate name and principal business activity coded under ISIC 5229 / CIIU 5229
Contact email and telephone for electronic notifications
Request for certificate of homonymy generated in RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, file a revised name through the same RUES workflow with no additional registry fee; the substitution is typically resolved within one business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and registration of the incorporation document and by-laws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (RUES) and, optionally, a Notaría for notarization of the private document
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Documento Privado de Constitución with the mandatory by-law clauses (corporate name, domicile, purpose, authorized capital, share classes, governance and liquidation rules); submit the final FUR, the pre-RUT, and the payment receipt for registro mercantil; the Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal and the definitive NIT confirmation. Where real property is contributed, formalize the constitution as Escritura Pública before a notary and file an authenticated copy with the Chamber.
required_dossiers: Documento Privado de Constitución / by-laws signed by the shareholder(s)
Formulario Único de Registro (FUR) fully completed
Pre-RUT / provisional NIT certificate
Proof of payment of registration fees and registry tax (derechos de inscripción y registro)
Certificate of homonymy
Bank receipt or sworn contribution affidavit evidencing paid-in capital
Beneficiary (UBO) declaration form for the Registro de Beneficiario Final per SIC regulations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues an 'exigencia' or rejection, cure the observation within the 10-business-day correction term via RUES; by-law defects are corrected by a ratificatory private document filed as an amendment before the same registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive tax registration, electronic invoicing enablement and corporate bank account opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) and the chosen commercial banking entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) using the definitive NIT and CIIU code 5229; obtain the DIAN-authorized electronic signature (firma electrónica) through a certified provider (e.g., Certicámara or GSE); request habilitation for electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) under Resolución DIAN 000165 de 2023; open the corporate bank account with the registered company documents and signatory powers, then update the RUT with the bank account details and the applicable tax regime indicators.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Pre-RUT / definitive NIT certificate
Proof of registered office address (lease or public-services bill)
Identity and UBO documentation of shareholders and legal representative
Bank account opening application and signatory registration form
Electronic signature service contract with the DIAN-authorized provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN returns a discrepancy in the RUT or e-invoicing habilitation, respond through the 'Usuario Registrado' portal within 10 working days and re-submit the corrected FUR; if the bank rejects the account application, rectify signatory powers by filing an updated certificate of existence with the Chamber.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of corporate books, officer appointments and UBO compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one (1) month of incorporation, present the corporate books (Libro de Accionistas, Libro de Actas de Asamblea, and Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva, if any) to the Chamber for legalization (certificación de libros); register the appointment of the Manager, Legal Representative and other officers through the appropriate RUES form; confirm the beneficiary final (UBO) filing required by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio and the Tax Administration.
required_dossiers: Standard form for book legalization (solicitud de registro de libros)
Designated corporate books, bound, numbered and complete
Current Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Power of attorney if filed by a third party
Minutes or written consent appointing the officers
UBO declaration of beneficial owners (format SIC Circular Externa No. 011 de 2021)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late book registration triggers fines under the Código de Comercio; cure by voluntary presentation before the Chamber's annual renovation deadline and, if the UBO record is incomplete, update it through the same RUES module without penalty during the correction period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social security, occupational-risk (ARL) and labor compliance registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: PILA (Planilla Integrada de Liquidación de Aportes) administered by ADRES; Administradoras de Riesgos Laborales (ARL); Ministerio del Trabajo (for SST program)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A.S. as an employer in the PILA system and affiliate all hired employees with an EPS, AFP, ARL and Caja de Compensación; contract the mandatory occupational health and safety system (SG-SST) under Resolución 0312 de 2019; upload the payroll operator or direct PILA registration with the company NIT and adjust the ARL class based on CIIU 5229; if no employees exist, maintain the employer status active and file 'sin novedad' monthly periods.
required_dossiers: Company NIT and Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Employer registration form in PILA
Identity documents of the legal representative and each employee
ARL contract and SG-SST implementation plan
Caja de Compensación affiliation receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ARL assigns a risk class inconsistent with CIIU 5229 office operations, present the SG-SST program and submit a formal reclassification request to the ARL; any late payroll obligation is cured by paying adjusted interest and reporting novedades in the next PILA cycle.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: NVOCC maritime operating authorization and international cargo-agent registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministerio de Transporte - Dirección de Transporte y Tránsito (modulo marítimo) through the Ventanilla Única de Transporte (VUT); Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo - Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior (VUCE) for the Registro de Agente de Carga Internacional; supervision by the Superintendencia de Transporte
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the application for the operating authorization of an 'Empresa de Servicios de Transporte Marítimo Internacional - Modalidad NVOCC' under Decreto 172 de 2001, as amended by Decreto 551 de 2022, via the VUT; evidence financial capacity, transport liability / P&I insurance, and a designated operations manager with maritime experience; simultaneously register the company as international cargo agent (Agente de Carga Internacional - ACI) with the VUCE under the applicable Ministry of Commerce resolution; upon approval, obtain the certification of existence in the national maritime transport registry and file the annual renewal prior to the calendar deadline.
required_dossiers: Company by-laws and Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT evidencing CIIU code 5229
Financial capacity certificate or audited financial statements (if volume thresholds apply)
P&I / transport liability insurance policy in force
Professional résumé of the legal representative and operations manager
Draft NVOCC bill of lading and service contract template
Proof of registered office and municipal operating license (matrícula de industria y comercio)
Proof of payment of VUT / VUCE application tariff
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Ministry or VUCE issues a requirement (requerimiento), cure within the 30-calendar-day term with supplementary evidence; a denial may be challenged through the recurso de reposición before the same authority and, subsidiarily, recurso de apelación before the higher official within 10 business days of notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal operating license, land-use certificate and fire-safety clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía Municipal / Distrital - Secretaría de Hacienda (industria y comercio); Secretaría de Planeación (uso de suelo); Cuerpo de Bomberos Oficial
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Request the Matrícula de Industria y Comercio at the municipal Treasury and obtain the Certificado de Uso de Suelo confirming office-commercial use compatible with freight-forwarding activities; contract and pass the annual fire-safety inspection with the Cuerpo de Bomberos to obtain the Certificado de Seguridad Humana y Contra Incendios; display the obligatory opening notice (aviso de apertura) if required by the local code; these clearances are conditions precedent for the physical operation of the office and for the validity of the NVOCC license.
required_dossiers: Lease contract or property title of the registered office
Certificado de Uso de Suelo issued by the planning authority
RUT / NIT and company certificate of existence
Memoria descriptiva (floor plan showing exits, evacuation routes and fire-equipment locations)
Cuerpo de Bomberos inspection request form and fee receipt
Fire-suppression and extinguisher maintenance contracts if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the land-use certificate is denied for the chosen address, relocate the registered office and file a 'cambio de domicilio' before the Chamber of Commerce, then reapply; fire-safety deficiencies require corrective structural and equipment works followed by a re-inspection within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Transporte - Dirección de Transporte y Tránsito (modulo marítimo) via Ventanilla Única de Transporte (VUT); Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo - Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior (VUCE), Registro de Agentes de Carga Internacional
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia / Autorización de Operación como Empresa de Servicios de Transporte Marítimo Internacional - Modalidad NVOCC (Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier), together with the Registro como Agente de Carga Internacional (ACI) ante el MinCIT

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) for port-linked infrastructure; Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) or municipal environmental authority for local discharge permits
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - office-based, non-industrial freight-forwarding brokerage has no mandatory EIA under Decreto 1076 de 2015, arts. 2.2.2.3.2.1 et seq.; a generator registration and environmental license become mandatory only if the company operates a warehouse, container yard or dispatch facility with hazardous-waste or significant discharge activities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For any ancillary warehouse or logistics facility: comply with Resolución 0631 de 2015 on wastewater discharges (pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 not exceeding 200 mg/L and TSS not exceeding 100 mg/L) before discharge to municipal sewerage requiring a Permiso de Vertimientos from the CAR; volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions, if generated by cleaning or maintenance operations, must meet the thresholds of Resolución 1652 de 2019; hazardous waste (e.g., container sweepings, contaminated rags, used oils) must be registered as generator and disposed through licensed managers under Decreto 4741 de 2005. A purely administrative NVOCC brokerage office is exempt from these discharge and emission thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Valid Certificado de Seguridad Humana y Contra Incendios issued by the Cuerpo de Bomberos; structural load and egress inspection certificate for the leased or owned office; compliance with the Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) under Resolución 0312 de 2019; mandatory ARL affiliation for all workers; and, for premises located in port-proximity zones, a civil-defense inspection covering seismic and flood-risk evacuation per municipal emergency planning codes.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); official portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional portal: muisca.dian.gov.co. DIAN is simultaneously the national tax and customs authority.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign shareholders incorporate the S.A.S. by private deed and file with the local Cámara de Comercio. Obtaining the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal is followed by enrollment in the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) through the MUISCA portal, after which DIAN issues the definitive NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria); the same NIT is used as the VAT identification. Non-resident shareholders may act through a general power of attorney in Colombia, no minimum capital is required, and no Notary protocol is mandatory unless real property or regulated assets are contributed.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists; a S.A.S. is always a separate income-tax taxpayer. Available statutory elections include opt-in to the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) for small taxpayers with gross revenues at or below statutory UVT thresholds, registration as a Zona Franca user where statutory export activity conditions are met, and the ordinary corporate income-tax deductions subject to documented productive asset investment, accelerated depreciation, and hybrid mismatch limitation rules under the E.T.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No economic turnover threshold applies to a juridical person: S.A.S. VAT registration in the RUT is compulsory from the first taxable supply. For natural persons, the non-responsible trader exclusion remains available only below 3,500 UVT of annual gross taxable income (approximately COP 174.3 million for tax year 2025).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT-responsible S.A.S. entities must issue the Factura Electrónica de Venta using DIAN-authorized software or an authorized Operador Tecnológico. Each invoice is generated in XML, signed digitally, assigned a CUFE/CUDE unique code and QR code, transmitted to DIAN for validation before delivery to the buyer, and acknowledged through DIAN web-service APIs. Export invoices must be cross-linked with the customs export declaration and the corresponding foreign-currency exchange documentation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exports qualify for zero-rated VAT if the goods physically leave the Colombian customs territory within the statutory deadline, the RUT records the entity as an exporter, the buyer is a foreign resident, and the foreign currency proceeds are repatriated through an authorized Colombian intermediary. For NVOCC ocean freight-forwarding services, zero-rating applies to the international ocean transportation and directly related offshore logistics segments, provided the service is contracted by a non-resident client and used or exploited exclusively outside Colombia; pre-carriage, terminal handling and local warehousing inside Colombia remain subject to 19% VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración Aduanera de Exportación (DAE/DEX) accepted by DIAN Customs through the SIDUNEA/MUISCA electronic platform
Commercial invoice, Master or House Bill of Lading, and cargo manifest evidencing the international movement of goods
Inward remittance certificate or Declaración de Cambio issued by an authorized Colombian banking intermediary evidencing collection of foreign currency
Service export contract and supporting documentation demonstrating utilization and economic exploitation outside Colombia for zero-rated offshore NVOCC services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may re-examine zero-rated export claims within the five-year limitation period; improper refunds are clawed back with interest, full indexation, and, in certain cases, a penalty for devolución improcedente. Sanción por inexactitud reaches 200% of the tax difference where the zero-rating position is based on inaccurate documentation. Fraudulent export invoicing and false customs declarations additionally expose the legal representative and the company to criminal liability, including customs-contraband offences and document falsification under the Código Penal, and may lead to exclusion from the DIAN refund program.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia), acting jointly with the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit, under the statutory foreign exchange regime set out in Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1735 of 1993, and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN 83 (Sistema de Cambios Internacionales).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia maintains a free-floating, market-regulated convertibility regime. Current-account transactions (including service exports such as NVOCC freight routing) are freely convertible through the official foreign exchange market (Mercado Cambiario). Capital-account transactions are subject to mandatory registration and periodic reporting; however, profit remittances and the repatriation of registered foreign investment are permitted without a surrender requirement provided all filings are in order. Conversion outside the regulated market is prohibited and treated as a violation of the Régimen Cambiario.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Circular DCIN 83, service-export proceeds including freight-forwarding invoices must be received through an authorized local intermediary or, if credited to a foreign account, repatriated to Colombia within six (6) months from the date of service performance. Upon effective receipt, the foreign currency must be converted into COP within three (3) business days (or by the next business day if credited in a local foreign-currency account). Proceeds must be reported using Formulario No. 6 ('Declaración de cambio por exportación de servicios') and supported by the NVOCC invoice issued to the foreign principal.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Payoneer, Mercury, Revolut Business) are not chartered in Colombia and have no legal capacity to receive FX declarations or interact with Banco de la República. Their practical use is limited to contingency collection of small, non-core receivables from foreign freight clients. Feasibility rating: Medium as a supplementary settlement channel for sub-USD 10,000 transactions, but Low as a primary or statutory compliant treasury rail. Colombian AML Circular Externa 009 of 2011 places responsibility on the entity to identify and report transactions routed through unregulated channels, so all significant operational and tax-obligation proceeds must be settled via local authorized intermediaries.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a medium-risk NVOCC entity, tier-1 Colombian banks do not categorically require non-resident directors to physically appear at a branch. Remote onboarding is possible via video call, biometric validation, apostilled corporate documents, and a local power of attorney in favor of the company's Colombian legal representative. The local legal representative must attend an in-person interview at the bank's main branch (typically Bogotá) and present original RUT (tax ID), commercial registry, and the SAS bylaws.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk customer base located in offshore financial centres (Panama, British Virgin Islands, Curaçao) or jurisdictions on FATF grey/dark lists.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide maritime bills of lading, commercial NVOCC freight contracts, the Colombian Maritime Authority (DIMAR) and Superintendencia de Transporte license, plus a customer-by-customer KYC file with ultimate beneficial owner declarations and commercial references.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Wire volumes disproportionately larger than the entity's paid-in capital and declared operational expenses.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit audited financial statements for the previous two years, the updated projection as per the NVOCC business plan, original Swift MT103/MT202 records detailing the purpose and counterparty of each cargo disbursement, and a board resolution approving the treasury policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Requests to route proceeds through third-party, shell, or offshore nominee accounts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a treasury policy explicitly prohibiting payments to undisclosed shell entities, a sworn certification of the full legal and beneficial ownership chain of every counterparty, and supporting cargo documentation proving the actual maritime movement is controlled by a registered and licensed vessel operator.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inability to evidence the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) structure due to holdings held by nominee shareholders or bearer-type entities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver the S.A.S. shareholder ledger, statutory UBO declarations for all natural persons owning 10% or more of equity, the issued RUT and certificate of incorporation, and a notarized affadavit from each ultimate shareholder confirming source of wealth.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injection from non-resident shareholders into the Colombian NVOCC must be routed to a local authorized intermediary via SWIFT MT103. The wire must reference the NIT (tax ID), the nature of remittance as 'Foreign Direct Investment', and assign the correct DIAN purpose code - C46 for foreign capital investment or C13 for foreign investment in local currency. For proceeds exceeding USD 500,000, a copy of the Foreign Investment Registration (Formulario No. 3) must be provided to the receiving bank, and the funds must be booked into a dedicated capital account before any operational use. Amounts up to USD 50,000 may be classified as ordinary service income and included in the obligation report; larger sums trigger separate registration with Banco de la República through the local bank.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements for carrier fees, vessel charter, port terminals, and international logistics costs must be executed via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for intermediary bank instructions) citing the underlying freight contract and Incoterms. Commercial documentary letters of credit (MT700) are viable when the NVOCC purchases a prior shipment or when a principal requires a trade-backed payment guarantee; however, the Colombian entity's primary disbursement rail remains SWIFT wire because most counterparty carrier payments are pre-agreed per booking and not LC-mediated. Each outbound wire exceeding the USD 10,000 threshold requires the filing of the corresponding foreign exchange declaration (Formulario No. 6 for service-related payments) and is subject to anti-money laundering screening under SAROFAC. ACH Direct (CUD) is only used for domestic COP disbursements to local suppliers, public entities, and payroll; it has no cross-border application.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/COP non-deliverable forward (NDF) traded with an authorized local counterparty for hedging receipt-in-trans-cy of USD-denominated freight revenue
Deliverable USD/COP forward (forward de libre uso) agreed on the Colombian official FX market when physical conversion at maturity is required for payment obligations
Cross-currency swap (swap de monedas / swap de tasas de cambio) for hedging currency and interest rate mismatches on medium-term vessel lease obligations or long-term bilateral credit

Currency option (call/put) contracts purchased from a local authorized derivative provider, provided that the underlying freight receivables or payables can be evidenced through an NVOCC cargo manifest or contractual P&L

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Commercial Registry Annual Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late surcharge of 1.5% per month on registration fee; fines up to 1% of registered assets; risk of administrative suspension of the company's commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Anual de Beneficiarios Finales (Annual UBO Declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio / Unidad Administrativa Especial Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) through the Beneficiarios Finales system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by March 31; additionally within 30 days following any change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines per Article 671 of the Tax Code (up to COP 10,000,000); forced registration; administrative penalty for non-reporting.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena Anual (Annual Third-Party Information Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally between May and July of the following tax year, per DIAN calendar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties of up to 15% of omitted amounts; fine of up to COP 2,800,000 for each incomplete transaction group.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit ('Revisor Fiscal') required if, in the prior fiscal year, total assets exceed 30,000 UVT, or gross income exceeds 30,000 UVT, or the number of employees exceeds 200.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by Colombia (Decreto 2420/2015); Group 3 entities apply IFRS for SMEs (Simplified IFRS).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The annual commercial registry renewal requires confirmation of current beneficial owners; updates must be filed with the Chamber of Commerce within one calendar month after any shareholding change, and a new annual UBO declaration must be submitted each year before March 31.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Registro de Junta Directiva)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday applies to a standard SAS. The 35% headline rate is the base corporate income tax (CIT) rate for the 2024-2025 tax years. A reduced 20% CIT rate is available only to taxpayers operating under a permanent Zona Franca (free trade zone) license, and export-oriented logistics services may benefit from certain VAT/paramilitary exclusions and fixed-asset expensing rules. NVOCC freight-forwarding income does not receive a preferential CIT rate outside careful free-zone structuring.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 210 – Declaración de Renta y Complementarios, filed electronically through the DIAN MUISCA portal (www.dian.gov.co).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a calendar-year fiscal year ending December 31, the return must be filed during the DIAN’s annual filing schedule, generally falling in September-October of the following year. The exact deadline is fixed by the final digits of the taxpayer’s NIT, and in no case may it be earlier than 180 calendar days after the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification number (NIT) including the verification digit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Not applicable to non-resident shareholders; the resident SAS files its own return under its Colombian NIT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross income generated by the NVOCC, comprising freight-forwarding fees, booking commissions, container handling charges, consolidation and deconsolidation service fees, and any ancillary logistics revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A resident SAS is taxed on its worldwide income; the non-resident shareholder does not file this return and has no direct reporting obligation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income less deductible operating costs: payments to ocean carriers, port terminal charges, container costs, customs brokerage, fuel surcharges, rent, employee salaries, depreciation, and arm’s-length payments to related parties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only Colombian-resident entities deduct costs; non-resident shareholders should not include Colombian NVOCC expenses on this form.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after applying permitted cost amortization and any tax-loss carryforward offset. Colombian rules allow NOL carryforwards without a fixed expiry but the annual offset is limited to 25% of pre-NOL income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders should verify the SAS’s NOL position and ensure the 25% annual cap is respected.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 71 & Box 85 – Tax consideration and final CIT
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income is multiplied by the 35% statutory corporate rate; advance income-tax/prepayments and current-year withholdings are credited to arrive at the final tax payable (or recoverable balance).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The tax withheld on dividend or sale profits is handled at the distribution stage; no non-resident credit is included on Form 210.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers an extemporaneity penalty equal to 5% of the tax due for each month or partial month of delay, capped at 100% of the tax, plus default interest at DIAN rates. For a zero-tax return, a minimum flat penalty applies (approximately COP 240,000 for 2025).

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on gross dividends paid to non-resident shareholders where the profits distributed have been taxed at the corporate level at 35%. No further Colombian income tax applies for the foreign recipient. If the distribution is made out of tax-exempt or insufficiently taxed profits, the statutory rate may rise to 35% or be adjusted under the applicable DTA.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a reduced DTA rate, the non-resident beneficial owner must provide the Colombian paying entity with (i) a valid Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) issued by the tax authority of the shareholder’s country of residence, (ii) a sworn declaration of beneficial ownership, and (iii) specific documentation evidencing the administrative relationship with the Colombian entity. This package must be delivered before the dividend payment is made. The Colombian SAS then applies the DTA rate directly; otherwise, the 10% statutory WHT is withheld and the foreign shareholder must seek a refund from DIAN, a process that generally requires demonstrating that the treaty was not applied at source.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for the use of software, trademarks, patents or other intellectual property paid to non-residents are subject to a 15% statutory withholding tax. Interest paid on foreign-currency credit loans is subject to 15% WHT, but a reduced 5% rate applies where the loan is a registered external credit (registered with the Banco de la República and made by an overseas financial institution subject to home-country supervision). DTA relief may further reduce these rates to 5-10% for interest and royalties, subject to procedural TRC filing.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: The Colombian SAS must prepare a Local File and a Master File, and file the annual Transfer Pricing Informative Return (Form 120), if in the prior tax year it had gross assets or gross income equal to or exceeding COP 5,000,000,000 (approximately 100,000 UVT), or if it is classified by DIAN as a large taxpayer, or if it executes transactions with foreign related parties of any amount and falls into the threshold. Even below the threshold, all NVOCC transactions with related parties must be documented on an arm’s-length basis.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not apply a Caribbean-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) regime. Nonetheless, DIAN applies substantive anti-abuse principles, substance-over-form rules and the general anti-avoidance rule (GAAR) contained in the Colombian Tax Code. An NVOCC SAS is expected to demonstrate real economic presence: a physical office in Colombia, operational staff, active P&L and bank account flows, contractual booking documentation, and actual management decisions taken in Colombia. Pure captive or shell forwarding structures risk re-characterization, loss of deductions, and piercing of the corporate veil.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willful omission of NVOCC revenue, under-invoicing of freight services, or overstatement of freight costs through fictitious subcontractors to reduce taxable profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN inexactness penalty of 100%-200% of the omitted tax, plus moratory interest and criminal sanctions under Article 434-A of the Colombian Criminal Code: imprisonment of 48 to 108 months and monetary fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Legal representatives, financial officers and directors with signatory power face personal criminal prosecution, travel bans, asset embargos, and civil liability for fraudulent management under Law 1258/2008.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or file the Local File, Master File or Form 120; failure to apply an arm’s-length rate to related-party ocean freight and logistics commissions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Late-filing penalty of up to 15,000 UVT (approx. COP 750 million); mandatory re-pricing with an understatement penalty of 20% of the additional tax; prohibition of related-party deductions and default-interest charges.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Administrators may be jointly liable for unpaid tax and penalties where they signed flawed documentation; DIAN can pursue director bank accounts and assets under solidary responsibility.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Use of a newly formed SAS with no physical office, no employees, no local insurance or operational log, and no independent authority to negotiate or execute NVOCC contracts, used solely as a tax conduit to channel revenue to a related offshore entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN and the Comisión de Sociedades may disregard the separate legal personality and pierce the corporate veil under Article 42 of Law 1258/2008, imposing CIT and penalties on the beneficial owner; penalty up to 200% of under-declared tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Shareholders and administrators become personally, jointly and severally liable for corporate tax debts, fines, and anti-money-laundering non-compliance; a criminal finding of tax fraud may add detention and travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting cash or uncorroborated wire payments for container cargo where the NVOCC is aware of misdeclared cargo, fictitious invoices, denials of export, or money laundering in high-risk trade lanes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of the SIC/RUNT operational license and the DIAN import/export authorization; fines under Colombian AML law (UIAF) up to COP 1.2 billion; criminal money-laundering penalties of 8-22 years imprisonment; possible confiscation of the very vessel cargo.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, AML compliance officers, beneficial owners and customs representatives face investigation by the UIAF and Fiscalía; personal property can be seized; travel bans and imprisonment are possible for those who knowingly facilitated the illegal cargo flow.
